violations.reason: The reservation 2KC8YP originally had destination LAS (step 7), but the user asked to change to flight HAT009 from PHX to SFO (step 2), and the agent called update_reservation_flights with a PHX-to-SFO HAT009 segment (step 16), resulting in the changed flight (step 17). This changes the reservation's destination from LAS to SFO, which the policy prohibits for flight modifications.
